title: Maximal regularity and caloric trace estimates in mixed Lebesgue norms for the heat equation
summary: We study the heat equation in the half-space with nonhomogeneous Dirichlet boundary data. For the caloric extension $v$ of the boundary data $g$, we prove maximal regularity estimates in mixed Lebesgue norms $L^p_tL^q_x$ for any order derivative of $v$ in terms of mixed Besov and Lizorkin--Triebel type norms of $g$. We also establish the corresponding reverse inequalities, which are caloric trace estimates recovering the boundary regularity of $g$ from the mixed-norm regularity of $v$.
